question: Which of the following Acts shifted the powers to the British Crown from the English East India Company?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Government of India Act,1858".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Act that transferred the power from the **British East India Company** to the British Crown in **India** became the **Government of India Act of 1858.**
 
• This changed into an Act surpassed via way of means of the British Parliament on **2 August 1858.**
 
• **Lord Palmerston**, then United Kingdom Prime Minister, proposed an invoice for the switch of strength from the East India Company to the British Crown in India was the **Government of India. **
